d: Short, voluminous platinum white hair with thick bangs and a choppy texture. Sharp, narrowed amber eyes with a determined expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build, wearing a cropped black jacket with orange accents, a high collar, and a black belt, paired with short black shorts, a white fabric wrap around the waist, and a black belt with silver buckles. Two golden metallic cat-ear shaped ornaments sit atop the head, and a thin orange patterned band is wrapped around the upper right thigh.
